column3: The earlier group is a collective cohort; this supports the temporal scope of "the first ones" without fixing its outcome.
Links present hearers and earlier ancestors under one Lord who gives life and death, widening 77:16 beyond an isolated past.
Qualifies destruction of settlements: active reform is presented as contrary to ruin.
Pairs a cohort of the earlier with one of the later, directly paralleling 77:16-17 without making either group identical to the other.
Supplies the immediate continuation: the later ones are made to follow the first ones.
Places messengers among earlier peoples, making the earlier period a repeated arena of address and response.
Names the destruction of the earlier 'Ad as a concrete precedent; the rejected recurrence reading remains only a contrast.

Joins destruction of stronger people to the passing example of the earlier ones, explicitly making precedent available.
States the generalizing consequence: this is how the criminals are dealt with.
